'''Yatter''' was an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who lived on [[Dorumaa]]. He worked for the [[Dorumaa Ecological Renovation Team]] and would spend his days researching and investigating Dorumaa's various [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Plant/Legends|flora]] and fauna. He was good friends with the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Wuglik]] and they would often meet up to watch sport together. On one occasion, they were playing [[Bannak]] and watching the [[Galactic lightball playoffs]] on a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] in the [[Cantina Oceana]] when [[Echari Di'San]] got into a fight with [[Rysko Barnt]]. Barnt was murdered shortly after and Yatter was asked some questions about the incident by some [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who had been hired by the [[Cularin Trade Alliance]] to investigate the [[Death/Legends|death]]. Yatter thought that it was obvious that Di'San had killed Rysko.
